citation.title: Neoclassical tearing modes and their control

topic: An invited review of neoclassical tearing mode (NTM) physics, onset/threshold scaling, seeding, and control by sawtooth regulation, applied helical fields, and LHCD/ECCD.
own_question: What sets NTM onset and stabilization, and how can NTMs be controlled toward ITER?
actual_method_and_evidence: Literature review using the modified Rutherford equation and multi-device results (TFTR, DIII-D, ASDEX Upgrade, JT-60U, JET, COMPASS-D). It does not address CES, impurity Ti, BES/ECEI-based temperature estimation, pedestal-top nowcasting, or KSTAR.
input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. The source reports real-time equilibrium reconstruction for ECCD alignment in DIII-D, but this is MHD control, not diagnostic nowcasting.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as support for CES temperature nowcasting or BES/ECEI information content.
Do not imply KSTAR NTM relevance, or that pedestal-top Ti relates to the islands discussed in the source.
Do not cite its real-time control as precedent for our timing or deployment claims.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Exclude. The source concerns core MHD stability and control, not our target, inputs, or estimation task. Any link would be a generic statement that profile control matters, which the framing disallows.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
